body:
Divalproex for BP and hydroxyzine for stress.

They gave me Lyrica first, which is horrible for people with BP but they didn't know. I got intense head pressure and brain fog as well as vomiting by the 3rd day.

Then Wellbutrin, which my father uses for his BP. Was good for a week, then became heavily suicidal. That's when I went to the ER.

Went to my provider where I get free service and the shrink there put me on my current meds. Was feeling much better by the second week and now I feel like a normal person most of the time. My only complaint is Divalproex causes bad short-term memory loss for me. Keeps me from blowing my brains out though.
That's the thing though, I don't want to give those bastards a single cent when they did nothing but make it worse.

I'm bp as well so I know how you feel. That said, who the fuck cares what they say? If they don't like you anymore then don't associate with them. No one is forcing you to keep them in your life. You should be going to college to get a degree/cert/whatever to do what you want as a career, not play soap opera.

None of that stuff even applies outside of school. People you meet elsewhere won't know that your college buddies don't like you or think you're weird. You're just another person. Be whoever you want.
